Asset type: a single premium anime-game VFX texture for a short Skirk-inspired void/ice burst on a dark navy website. Actual transparent alpha background.

Fine silver-cyan highlights and faint nebula wisps close to the ring, bright refractive edges, angular shard silhouettes and tapered energy filaments. Sophisticated crystalline cosmic ice energy, not orange fire, not a generic magic circle. Rich periwinkle, ultramarine and icy cyan with tiny white accents. Slightly three-dimensional, painted anime game VFX, high quality. The central dark orb occupies 20% of the whole square, the corona 65%, scattered shards reach 85%; generous fully transparent margin on all sides. Centered composition, square 1024x1024.
No background fill, no checkerboard pattern, no ground, no UI, no words, no symbols, no labels, no person, no weapons. The image will be rotated and scaled as a layered effect, so transparent edges are essential.
